description: Defines the interface class 'pucch_allocator' for PUCCH scheduling in a 5G NR context, including methods for resource allocation, removal, and status checks related to PUCCH grants.

classes.name: pucch_allocator
classes.description: Interface class for PUCCH resource allocation and management in 5G NR.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Signals a new slot to reset the PUCCH common allocation grid.

methods.name: alloc_common_harq_ack
methods.description: Allocates a common PUCCH resource for HARQ-ACK for a UE.

methods.name: alloc_common_and_ded_harq_ack
methods.description: Allocates both common and dedicated PUCCH resources for HARQ-ACK for a UE.

methods.name: alloc_ded_harq_ack
methods.description: Allocates a dedicated PUCCH HARQ-ACK grant for a UE.

methods.name: alloc_sr_opportunity
methods.description: Allocates the PUCCH resource for a UE's SR opportunity.

methods.name: alloc_csi_opportunity
methods.description: Allocates the PUCCH grant for a UE's CSI opportunity.

methods.name: remove_ue_uci_from_pucch
methods.description: Removes UCI allocations on PUCCH for a UE and returns the number of HARQ-ACK and CSI bits removed.

methods.name: has_common_pucch_grant
methods.description: Checks if a common PUCCH grant exists for a UE at a specific slot.
